svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Devcontainer image and its runtime
svg.desc: The image is built once from the Dockerfile and every tool in it is root-owned and read-only. The dev user runs the agents and git from /workspace; the wrapper is what forces the factory hooks to run there.
